semantic.justification: Original public osl_copyFile/osl_removeFile and consumed File wrapper are now ported: URL conversion and already approved read/create/write gates, source lstat/destination stat, wasm32 source size cast, .osl-tmp backup and ignored cleanup/rollback errors, source link-content copying and regular-file 0x7fff buffered copy with original errno/ENOSPC behavior. Exact native destination open omits TRUNC/EXCL. Genuine SDK FS errors publish native errno; no synthetic syscall provider, host filesystem mount, or metadata-preserving move branch is introduced. Active original File copy/remove QA assertions and actual descriptor/permissions/link/backup regression tests are present. Native EINTR, zero-progress write assertion, source races/OOM and full SvFileStream/TempFile/package/storage/model/filter/UI acceptance remain unqualified or unfinished. Coverage gaps are recorded without lowering90 thresholds.
